claims.statement: Council Directive 91/676/EEC concerns protection of waters against pollution caused by nitrates from agricultural sources.
Poland's nitrate programme requires annual parcel-level nitrogen plans for specified larger farms and fertilizer-application records for farms at stated lower thresholds.

contrary_evidence: Poland already offers the compliant INTER-NAW planning tool, so a generic calculator has little differentiation.

economics.acquisition_route: One-to-many distribution through soil laboratories, cooperatives, agronomy advisers, and input distributors.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 12 channels each producing 10000 field plans at 60 PLN retained revenue yields 7.2 million PLN annual revenue by year five and can support founder equity above 5 million PLN without double-counting cash.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 3-4 founder hours daily on modeling and channels while licensed agronomists own recommendations.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 60-70% gross margin after channel share, weather data, agronomist QA, and support.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: a 10000 PLN laboratory onboarding pays back in one season at 200 plans.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis, including the capital figure: 149 PLN per field-season plan with 35% paid to the laboratory or cooperative.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every crop year, assay round, field change, and weather-driven amendment creates a paid planning event.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Consented local links among assays, applications, weather, crop, and yield outcomes improve field recommendations
fingerprint.customer: Polish arable farms served by soil laboratories and cooperatives
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Laboratory result portals and cooperative agronomy programs
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Lab-attached field plan sold per season with a channel revenue share
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The farmer pays when a field-season plan and record pack is issued
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A seasonal assay arrives or an annual nitrogen plan must be documented

founder_fit: This is a measurable data flywheel sold through one-to-many channels and can begin with a narrow Polish region.
risks: Bad plans can reduce yield or pollute water, requiring agronomist approval and clear separation from fertilizer sales incentives.

structure.control_point: The conversion of a soil assay into a documented field-level nitrogen plan
structure.critical_dependency: Laboratory and cooperative channels plus farmer consent for outcome data

thesis: Let soil laboratories and cooperatives attach a field-specific nitrogen plan to every seasonal assay, charging per field while pooling consented soil, crop, weather, application, and yield-response observations.
title: NitraCycle Lab-to-Field Planner
uncertainties: The incremental predictive value of pooled local outcomes over free tools is unknown.
